usage: The word '腳' (goek3) means 'foot' and is used to refer to the body part below the ankle.
'腳' can be used on its own or with measure words when counting or describing multiple feet.
In sentences, '腳' can function as the subject, object, or part of a noun phrase.
You can use '腳' to describe actions related to the foot, such as walking, hurting, or stepping.
Common phrases often include '腳痛' (foot pain) or '洗腳' (wash feet), showing how '腳' connects to health and daily activities.
